rules: Derive total electrons as sum(n*Z)-reported charge;do not parse charge or multiplicity from an IDsuffix. For an electronic spin label M=2S+1,an even-electron state requires odd positive M and an odd-electron state requires even positive M. This is a necessary parity constraint,not proof of a physically accurate ground state. Inspect the vacuum NONErow of the published open-shell flag.
scope: Molecular record bookkeeping only. An open-shell flag does not uniquely determine multiplicity or magnetic ground-state energy;no missing electron-count field may be invented.
